analytics.name: Analytic 1745
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Subvert Trust Controls by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: PackageInstaller.install() with installer_source NOT IN $ApprovedInstallSources$ within $PolicyViolationWindow$ of settings change]; System Settings via Android Enterprise DPC [DevicePolicyManager policy/compliance/security-state queries and SecurityLog events where supported]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: MDM agent, OTA update service. Derive from MDM platform documentation.
Default 1800s (30 min) between settings change and install.

log_sources.name: mobile:ForensicArtifacts
log_sources.channel: Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: PackageInstaller.install() with installer_source NOT IN $ApprovedInstallSources$ within $PolicyViolationWindow$ of settings change

log_sources.name: android:DevicePolicyManager
log_sources.channel: DevicePolicyManager policy/compliance/security-state queries and SecurityLog events where supported

analytics.name: Analytic 1746
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect Subvert Trust Controls from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: app binary written to device with signing certificate matching manually-trusted enterprise cert NOT IN $EnterpriseCertAllowList$ within $ProfileInstallWindow$]; Protected Configuration via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Approved enterprise signing certificate fingerprints. Derive from IT certificate management system.
Default 3600s between profile/cert trust and app install.

log_sources.name: mobile:ApplicationVetting
log_sources.channel: Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys

log_sources.name: mobile:ForensicArtifacts
log_sources.channel: Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: app binary written to device with signing certificate matching manually-trusted enterprise cert NOT IN $EnterpriseCertAllowList$ within $ProfileInstallWindow$

log_sources.name: iOS:MDM
log_sources.channel: DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries
